summary: Mars aspecting the lagna gives a martial, courageous, quick-tempered and physically robust nature, with scars or injuries, and in Saravali a combative, righteous streak.
common_outcomes: fond of bold deeds and fights, irritable, prone to broken relationships, yet very righteous (Saravali 34.1-7)
martial nature, ruddy and sturdy body (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4, chart notes)
scars on the body (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4, chart notes)
a fiery person, especially if Mars also aspects the lagna lord (Frawley p. 216)
rare_outcomes: Lagna aspected by Mars while the 6th lord is in the 10th, 7th or 1st: harm from enemies' black magic (Jataka Parijata 6.93).
Sun in the lagna aspected by Mars: colic, consumption and asthma (Jataka Parijata 6.62); Raman repeats this as asthma or lung trouble (HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).
Saravali 34.1-7 also names strong sexual vigour as a Mars-aspect trait.

Aspects on the natal Moon (the Moon treated as a second lagna, BPHS ch. 12): Phaladeepika 18.6-11 gives Mars's aspect on the Moon as kingship in Aries, Leo, Scorpio and Capricorn; poverty in Taurus; trade in iron tools in Gemini; a warrior in Cancer; cleverness in Virgo; a rogue in Libra; a cheat in Sagittarius; liaisons with others' spouses in Aquarius; sinfulness in Pisces.

by_area.personality: Brave, combative, fiery, quick to anger, principled (Saravali 34.1-7; Frawley p. 216).
by_area.health: Robust build but scars, cuts and heat-related trouble (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 4).

strengtheners: Saravali 34.8: Aries or Scorpio lagna aspected by its own lord Mars gives happiness, wealth and closeness to rulers.
Mars as yogakaraka or lagna lord (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 2; HPA ch. XIII).
weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.10-11: a malefic aspecting the lagna is inauspicious unless it owns it.
Mars combust in a Raman case 'aspects the lagna adversely' (HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart notes).
lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 1 fully from the 7th (7th aspect), the 10th (4th aspect) and the 6th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.1-7
source_views.view: If Mars aspects the ascendant one is fond of valorous acts and battles, irascible, has severed relationships, is very righteous and sexually well endowed.

source_views.source: Saravali (tr. R. Santhanam) 34.8, 34.10-11
source_views.view: A planet aspecting its own sign as lagna gives happiness, wealth, royal favour; otherwise a malefic aspect on the lagna is inauspicious.

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 6.62, 6.93
source_views.view: Sun in the lagna aspected by Mars: colic, consumption and asthma; lagna aspected by Mars with the 6th lord in the 10th, 7th or 1st: suffering from enemies' magic.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope vol. 1 ch. 4 (First House), general rules and chart notes
source_views.view: Mars aspect on the lagna gives martial nature, ruddiness, healthy constitution, sturdy figure and scars; the Sun in the lagna aspected by Mars gives asthma or lung trouble.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers p. 216

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 1950) 18.6-11
source_views.view: Moon in each sign aspected by Mars (first in the list).

source_views.view: Mars aspects the 4th and 8th besides the 7th; these aspects are sometimes evil and sometimes beneficial: when Mars is a yogakaraka (e.g. lord of 4 and 9) and aspects a friendly planet by his 4th aspect, the significations of that planet and house are greatly enhanced; the same holds for the 8th aspect.

source_views.source: BPHS (tr. R. Santhanam, vol. 1) 26.2-5
source_views.view: Besides sign aspects, planets aspect the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th, 4th/8th and 7th from themselves with strength rising by quarters (1/4, 1/2, 3/4, full) and give results in proportion; all planets aspect the 7th fully; Saturn, Jupiter and Mars have special (full) aspects on the 3rd/10th, 5th/9th and 4th/8th respectively. Exact aspect values are then computed from longitudes (26.6-12).

source_views.source: Brihat Jataka (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, 2nd ed.) 2.13
source_views.view: Same scheme: quarter glance on 3rd/10th, half on 5th/9th, three-quarters on 4th/8th, full on 7th; Saturn is strong in his 3rd/10th glance, Jupiter auspicious in his 5th/9th, Mars potent in his 4th/8th. summary: Mars aspecting the 2nd sharpens intellect, calculation and memory and gives a cutting tongue; with the luminaries in the 2nd or 12th and Saturn's influence it is named in eye disease.
common_outcomes: sharp, piercing intelligence with a mathematical bent and strong memory (Frawley pp. 284-285, 290-291, chart readings)
sharp, sarcastic speech (Frawley pp. 284-285)
rare_outcomes: Moon or Sun in the 2nd (and the other luminary in the 12th) conjoined with or aspected by Saturn and Mars: eye disease (Phaladeepika ch. 14).
Mars aspecting the 2nd from both the lagna and the Moon recorded in a limb-trouble case (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 9, chart notes).

by_area.health: Eye strain when the luminaries in the 2nd/12th are also afflicted (Phaladeepika ch. 14).

summary: Mars is the significator of younger siblings; joined by the 3rd lord, his aspect on the 3rd favours brothers and courage, but his aspect on Saturn or Mercury in the 3rd harms co-born or friends.
common_outcomes: the 3rd lord together with Mars aspecting the 3rd: good results for the 3rd house (BPHS 14.2)
Moon alone in the 3rd aspected by male planets (Mars is one): younger brothers (BPHS 14.12-13)
planets aspecting the 3rd increase the number of younger co-born (Saravali 34.21-24)
rare_outcomes: Saturn in the 3rd aspected by Mars destroys co-born; Mercury in the 3rd aspected by Mars harms friends (Saravali 34.21-24).
The 3rd and 11th houses influenced by Saturn and Mars: ear disease (Phaladeepika ch. 14); Raman's deafness cases have Mars aspecting the 3rd (HJH vol. 1 ch. 6).

by_area.personality: Courage and enterprise (BPHS 14.1 associates the 3rd with courage).
by_area.health: Hearing trouble with Saturn's added influence (Phaladeepika ch. 14).
by_area.family: Younger brothers and support from siblings when Mars joins the 3rd lord's aspect (BPHS 14.2, 14.12-13); harm to co-born when Mars aspects Saturn there (Saravali 34.21-24).

strengtheners: BPHS 14.2: Mars with the 3rd lord aspecting (or occupying) the 3rd.
Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 6: Mars's aspect on the 3rd is more powerful from his own sign.
weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars and Saturn both aspecting the 3rd are bad for it (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 6, chart notes).
lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 3 fully from the 9th (7th aspect), the 12th (4th aspect) and the 8th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

summary: Mars aspecting the 4th brings energy and technical, practical bent to learning and property matters; as a malefic it is risky for vehicles and peace at home unless Mars is a functional benefic.
common_outcomes: energy in studies; a technical or engineering bent, especially from a watery sign (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 10, Practical Examples)
Ketu in the 4th aspected by Mars: a visionary who is grounded in matter-of-fact science (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 7, chart notes)
a malefic related to the 4th brings vehicle losses and accidents (BPHS 15.10-14)
rare_outcomes: Classical combination: Saturn in the 10th, Mars aspecting the 4th and the Sun aspecting the 7th: [maraka: text predicts death by assassination] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII).
Sun in the 4th aspected by Mars (or Saturn): obstacles in life (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 7).

strengtheners: Mars as 4th lord aspecting the 4th from his own sign (Raman HJH vol. 1 ch. 7 chart notes; Raman HPA ch. XIII).
Mars as yogakaraka (Cancer, Leo lagnas) aspecting the 4th enhances it (Raman HPA ch. XIII).

summary: Mars's aspect on the 8th (from the 1st, 2nd or 5th) is read in Raman's longevity cases as a sign of sudden or violent events; with Saturn in the 8th it harms marital understanding.
common_outcomes: Saturn in the 8th aspected by Mars (especially by the 4th or 8th aspect) is not conducive to mutual understanding in marriage (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI)
rare_outcomes: Mars aspecting the 8th with Saturn in a Nigala drekkana: [maraka: text links it to death in captivity] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart).
8th aspected by Mars who is 7th from the Moon: [maraka: death by poisoning in a case] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart).
8th from the Moon (Scorpio) aspected by Mars from a fiery sign with Rahu: a highly malefic aspect (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart).
Retrograde planet in the 6th, 8th or a kendra in a sign of Mars and aspected by Mars: [maraka: text gives the child 3 years] (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, balarishta list).
Rahu in the 8th aspected by Mars: carbuncle (Phaladeepika 14.27).

by_area.health: Accidents, surgery or sudden crises in Raman's cases (HJH vol. 2 ch. XII).
by_area.relationships: Friction with the partner when Mars aspects Saturn in the 8th (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XI).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Mars with Rahu or in a fiery sign makes the aspect harsher (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XII, chart notes).
lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 8 fully from the 2nd (7th aspect), the 5th (4th aspect) and the 1st (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.

summary: Mars aspecting Jupiter in the 9th gives gold and wealth; on the 9th itself Raman's cases read Mars as a blemish to father, fortune or freedom.

summary: Mars aspecting the 10th gives a forceful career in engineering, the armed forces, law, printing, medicine or property, and in Raman's cases authority with a combative edge.
common_outcomes: Mars aspecting the 10th or its lord: immovable property from the father (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV)
lagna and lagna lord aspected by Mars from the 10th: an armed-forces career (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)
Mars and Jupiter aspecting the 10th and its lord: a post of authority (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)
Mars aspecting the 10th in great strength (with neecha-bhanga) and Mercury as 6th lord: a forceful lawyer (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV, chart)

rare_outcomes: Mars aspecting the 10th with Saturn-Mars in the 7th and the Sun aspected by Saturn: a rise from humble life to dictatorship and a violent end, in a Raman case (HJH vol. 2 ch. XIV).

Sastri's note: Mars as lord of war has full sight on the 4th (grave) and 8th (death).

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, Hindu Predictive Astrology ch. XIII (On Aspects)
source_views.view: Aspects are counted sign to sign; a planet aspecting its own house increases that house's signification; the 7th-house opposition is extremely good when formed by Jupiter and the Moon; for ordinary prediction count only full (7th) aspects and the special aspects of Saturn, Jupiter and Mars.

source_views.source: David Frawley, Astrology of the Seers ch. 'Planetary Aspects and Combinations', pp. 167-175
source_views.view: Vedic aspects fall on whole signs and on houses even when empty, improving or harming the house according to the aspecting planet's nature, not the angle; gives the same 1/4-1/2-3/4-full scheme, with special aspects counted full.

source_views.source: P.V.R. Narasimha Rao, Vedic Astrology: An Integrated Approach ch. 10.1-10.4
source_views.view: Graha drishti is an influence from the planet's inherent nature on the house and on planets in it; its success depends on the whole situation. Lists only the full aspects (7th for all; 4/8 Mars, 5/9 Jupiter, 3/10 Saturn).

disagreements: Saravali 34.60 lists Mars's 11th-house gains positively, while 34.65 says malefic influence reduces 11th-house effects. summary: Mars's aspect on the 12th spoils the wealth-saving effect of benefics there and appears with eye trouble and wasteful spending.
common_outcomes: Jupiter, a waxing Moon or Venus in the 12th increase wealth only if Mars does not aspect them (Saravali 34.69-70)
rare_outcomes: Sun in the 12th aspected by Mars or Saturn: defective vision (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI).
Luminaries in the 12th and 2nd aspected by Saturn and Mars: eye disease (Phaladeepika ch. 14).
12th with malefics aspected by Mars and the Moon: money wasted on pleasures and racing (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).
12th lord and lagna lord Mars aspecting the 12th with Jupiter and Saturn: life spent propagating a faith (Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI, chart).

by_area.finance: Spending or losses rise; benefic savings in the 12th are undone (Saravali 34.69-70).
by_area.health: Eye strain under combined Mars-Saturn influence (Phaladeepika ch. 14; Raman HJH vol. 2 ch. XVI).

weakeners_or_cancellations: Saravali 34.69-70: Mars's aspect cancels the wealth growth that benefics in the 12th would give.
BPHS 23.11: the 12th and its lord with and aspected by malefics: wandering from country to country.
lagna_or_context_notes: Mars aspects house 12 fully from the 6th (7th aspect), the 9th (4th aspect) and the 5th (8th aspect); BPHS 26.4 makes the 4th and 8th aspects full for Mars, while Brihat Jataka 2.13 stresses Mars's potency through them.
